name: apply_chest_wall_lowpass_filter
mechanism: Applies a low-pass filter to the audio signal to simulate the acoustic attenuation of the chest wall, reducing unrealistic high-frequency content.

name: add_baseline_wander_component
mechanism: Introduces a very low-frequency baseline wander component generated from filtered white noise to simulate sensor movement and reduce unrealistic zero-crossing rates.

name: randomize_component_frequencies
mechanism: Randomizing the frequency parameters of individual signal components and filters increases spectral diversity across generated samples.

name: reduce_spectral_cutoff_frequencies
mechanism: Decreased the frequency ranges for murmur bandpass and ambient/chest lowpass filters to reduce the zero-crossing rate and better match empirical acoustic characteristics.
